failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Multiple pre-existing/environmental test failures unrelated to the change (e2e-integration, intent-analysis, and lib-daemon-failure suites) causing the full suite run to fail
failures.fix: Investigate and fix sw-e2e-integration-test, sw-intent-analysis-test, and sw-lib-daemon-failure-test individually, or exclude environment-dependent e2e/integration suites from the standard test gate

failures.root_cause: Test suite uses stale fixtures/mocks expecting pipeline artifacts (plan.md, review.md) and jq-parseable pipeline_id output that the current pipeline implementation no longer produces in that format
failures.fix: Update sw-pipeline-test.sh mocks and assertions to match current artifact paths/output format for plan, review, and intelligence complexity stages

failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: Progress reveal function likely counts only the first assertion line per test instead of all matched checkmarks, undercounting pass total when a test's output spans multiple ✓ lines
failures.fix: Fix the pass-count aggregation in the memory promotion test's reveal/summary logic to count all ✓ occurrences per test block, not just the first

failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-loop-test fail with exit 1, and sw-e2e-integration-test hangs and hits the 300s timeout, indicating regressions or flaky/hanging behavior across three suites
failures.fix: Run sw-intent-analysis-test.sh and sw-loop-test.sh locally with verbose output to isolate the failing assertions, and profile sw-e2e-integration-test.sh for a hang (likely a blocking network/API call or missing mock) before re-running the suite

failures.pattern: Testing CONTRACT: pm can parse recruit team --json for team/agents/model... ERROR: scripts/sw-recruit-test.sh:1131 exited with status 5
failures.root_cause: sw-recruit-test.sh:1131 asserts 'pm can parse recruit team --json' expects team/agents/model keys but actual JSON output shape from `recruit team --json` diverged from what the test's parser expects
failures.fix: Compare current `shipwright recruit team --json` output against the assertion in sw-recruit-test.sh:1131 and update either the JSON schema emitted by sw-recruit.sh or the test's jq query to match

failures.root_cause: E2E test env not being cleaned/reset between runs causes stale artifacts (plan.md/review.md never generated) and one jq parse error on malformed RL episode JSON, cascading into 6 failures
failures.fix: Ensure pipeline_test setup regenerates a clean pipeline-artifacts dir per test and quote/validate JSON before piping to jq in the intelligence complexity test

failures.root_cause: sw-intent-analysis-test failed (exit 1) and sw-e2e-integration-test hit a 301s timeout, together accounting for the 4 FAIL count
failures.fix: Investigate the intent-analysis assertion failure directly and increase or diagnose the e2e-integration-test timeout (likely a hung external/API call)

failures.root_cause: Two of the four failures are pre-existing/environmental (stale daemon auth-check assertion and a leftover pipeline lock blocking e2e-integration), while sw-intent-analysis-test and sw-project-detect-test reflect real logic gaps: analyze_intent's JSON schema is missing required fields, and cached project detection doesn't return a stable/matching result on second read
failures.fix: Add version/goal/criteria to the analyze_intent output schema, make project_detect_all read-through the cache consistently instead of recomputing, and clear the stale pipeline lock before sw-e2e-integration-test runs
